name: course-outline-sol
description: Decision 2026-09-17: switch course-outline-proposal from gpt-5.6-luna to gpt-5.6-sol after an 8-profile head-to-head (scripts/compare_outline_models.py). Sol consistently included one more genuinely relevant module in ~half the profiles (safety/reliability for an LLM-features PM course, effect sizes for a nurse/statistics course, data-cleanup for a VBA course, gentler on-ramp for a non-technical SQL course); no profile favored luna. Cost difference is negligible in absolute terms (this runs once per learner, not per turn: ~$0.0005 -> ~$0.008). Applied on top of baseline-2026-09 -- only this one prompt changes.
